uncited: It computes the projected 2D covariance and conic parameters for each splat, determines the bounding box in screen space, and passes the necessary data to the fragment shader for alpha blending.

It differs from sibling methods by handling the full projection pipeline (view-space to screen-space covariance) and degenerate case culling within the vertex stage, relying on the parent [Gaussian Splat Rendering (Screen-Space Quad)](2075-gaussian-splat-rendering-screen-space-quad.md) for quad assembly and transparency handling.
- Clip-space position of the quad center.
**Pass Data to Fragment Shader**: Output `vQuadSize`, `vConic`, `vAlpha`, and `vColor`.
If `DebugMode` is 1, color is set to cluster colors (Nanite-style debug).
It operates as a core component of the GPU rendering pipeline for differentiable Gaussian splatting, handling per-splat projection and culling before fragment shading.
